dedupe_keys.name: trentino drinking water sources and protection zones

description: Autonomous Province of Trento publishes the Carta delle Risorse Idriche, covering springs, wells and surface-water sources used for drinking water, strategic reserves and their absolute-protection, hydrogeological-respect and protection zones. Coverage is Trentino. These source locations and protective zones provide water-supply capacity planning and water-quality context for infrastructure simulations. The grouped resource has 12 native metadata entries; versions, map sheets and complementary representations are retained together where the provider defines the same resource. The metadata permits public access and states a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Metadata is publicly readable; charges for obtaining or using the underlying material are not established here. Access is through the linked native metadata, which lists the provider routes and declared formats. Some strategic sources are reserves and are not used for present supply. Protection-zone geometry can be indicative and does not by itself prove current abstraction capacity or legal status. Accuracy and current completeness remain unverified. No distribution, map, feature or document body was downloaded. Descriptive metadata dates range from 2025-11-26 to 2025-11-27; these dates are not treated as asset observation dates. Related regional or municipal inventories describe other physical assets or broader source catalogues.
